errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the lowest yield was in 2021 with a value of approximately 160,000 tons. The chart shows that the lowest yield was in 2020 (approximately 158,000 tons), while the yield in 2021 was significantly higher (approximately 178,000 tons).
